rdfs:label: summaryMap
rdfs:comment: Language-tagged variants of an ActivityStreams Object's `summary` — keys are BCP 47 language tags, values are the localised summary strings. A JSON-LD `@language`-map alias for `as:summary`, not a separate RDF property.
notes: JSON-LD alias: in the AS2 context `summaryMap` is `as:summary` with `@container: @language`, so in RDF it is just language-tagged `as:summary` literals; it has no IRI of its own. On the fediverse, `summary` is also used as the content warning / spoiler text — `summaryMap` lets that warning be translated alongside the post body. Pair with `contentMap` so the visible warning matches the language of the content the user will reveal. The example carries inline context terms with `@container: @language` so the maps actually expand. It carries no owl:sameAs of its own: the RDF property is `https://www.w3.org/ns/activitystreams#summary`, which the registry maps via `urn:solid:summary`; this term only names the JSON-LD alias.

examples.title: A Note with localised content warning

contentMap.en: I cannot believe what just happened…
contentMap.fr: Je n'arrive pas à croire ce qui vient de se passer…

history.note: owl:sameAs -> as:summary (summaryMap is the AS2 context's @language-map alias); example gets inline @language context for summaryMap and contentMap. owl:sameAs moved to seeAlso (one registry term per upstream IRI).
